description: Source code for rdkx_logger implementation, including configuration loading, log level management, and formatted logging functions with support for color, timestamps, and module-specific settings.

methods.name: XLOG_INIT
methods.description: Initialize logger with module ID, filename, max file size, color option, and curtail option.

methods.name: XLOG_INIT_USER_PRINT
methods.description: Initialize logger with custom print functions.

methods.name: XLOG_LEVEL_GET
methods.description: Get current log level for a module.

methods.name: XLOG_LEVEL_SET
methods.description: Set log level for a specific module.

methods.name: XLOG_LEVEL_SET_ALL
methods.description: Set log level for all modules.

methods.name: XLOG_LEVEL_ACTIVE
methods.description: Check if a log level is active for a module.

methods.name: XLOG_PRINTF_SAFE
methods.description: Safely print a string with formatting options.

methods.name: XLOG_FPRINTF_SAFE
methods.description: Safely print a formatted string to a FILE stream.

methods.name: XLOG_PRINTF
methods.description: Print formatted log message to stdout.

methods.name: XLOG_FPRINTF
methods.description: Print formatted log message to a FILE stream.

methods.name: XLOG_DPRINTF
methods.description: Print formatted log message to a file descriptor.

methods.name: XLOG_SNPRINTF
methods.description: Format log message into a string buffer.
